name: Dungeon Stake: Kings & Knights
description: A browser 5v5 team-voted chess raid. Heroes and enemies pick classes, ready up, discuss in private team chat and vote for legal moves. A server resolves each 60-second turn. Phase 1 uses mock stakes and payouts only; no blockchain integration is implemented.
problem: Team strategy games often need demanding real-time controls. Dungeon Stake turns chess into a shared tactical conversation where five teammates each have one vote and a minute to agree.
userFlow: Run npm ci and npm run dev, then open http://localhost:3000.
Pick a class and enter a name. Create a raid and share its code, or fill empty seats with labeled demo bots.
Press Ready. Once all ten seats are ready, watch the raid transition into a chess battle.
On your team turn, discuss and vote using SAN such as e4. The server plays the leading legal move at 60 seconds. Demo hosts can resolve early.
Checkmate or a team clock timeout ends the raid and settles pretend coins. Draws refund everyone. Run npm test to verify the engine.
